lessons_used: Reordering sign-in steps consistently hurt performance and caused negative impacts across tests.
Adoption copy changes showed no clear effect across multiple tests.
Evidence is still thin for home, new_flow changes as there is only 1 test so far.
Evidence is still thin for finish, notification changes as there is only 1 test so far.
Evidence is still thin for choose_path, redesign, finish, layout, and home, wait_info changes as each has only 1 test so far.
Predictions were generally too high across almost all tests.

candidates.title: choose_path_stage_layout
candidates.change: Redesign the choose_path screen into a stage layout featuring animated mascot highlights to help users quickly pick their onboarding path.
candidates.why: The choose_path step has a high mean duration of 514s and a 23.8% drop-off, indicating users freeze when deciding.

guard.reason: Redesigning choose_path screen layout while preserving core options is allowed.

candidates.score_note: choose_path redesign previously dropped conversion by -8.9% and requires new screens.

candidates.title: home_intro_pet_interaction_tutorial
candidates.change: Add a new pet interaction tutorial screen during home_intro to demonstrate desktop pet movement and key controls.
candidates.why: Support received 3 emails regarding confusion over how to control, hide, or talk to the pet after onboarding.

candidates.title: pick_friend_personality_quiz
candidates.change: Introduce a pet personality preference questionnaire on pick_friend using choice cards to help users select their ideal companion.
candidates.why: Adoption conversion is low at 60.9% with a mean duration over 1000s, suggesting hesitation during pet selection.

components.text: What type of companion fits your work style?

guard.reason: Adding a personality quiz to assist pet selection on pick_friend preserves core functionality.

candidates.score_note: Adoption has high drop-off (39.1%), but creating a full personality quiz requires new screens.

candidates.title: sign_in_spotlight_reassurance
candidates.change: Redesign sign_in screen to a spotlight layout focusing on cloud sync assurances to guarantee pets are saved.
candidates.why: 8 support emails complained about pets missing or being reset after signing in again.

sign_in.headline: Sync your account to save your pet
sign_in.body: Signing in ensures your pet and desktop progress are safely backed up across devices.

guard.reason: Redesigning the sign_in screen layout with sync assurances is permitted inside onboarding.

candidates.score_note: Both funnel (27.1% drop-off) and 8 support emails highlight missing pet reassurance, though redesign carries cost.

candidates.title: waiting_desktop_diagnostic_checklist
candidates.change: Add a diagnostic checklist component on the waiting screen showing desktop rendering readiness checks.
candidates.why: 3 support tickets reported pets failing to show up on the desktop after onboarding.

guard.reason: Adding diagnostic checklist information to the waiting screen is permitted.

candidates.score_note: Supported by support tickets and funnel wait time; home wait_info previously saw +2.5% lift.

candidates.title: home_intro_checklist_layout
candidates.change: Switch home_intro to a checklist layout showing key onboarding completion tasks.
candidates.why: Finish step conversion drops to 64.8% with an average completion time of nearly 100 minutes.

home_intro.headline: Your Desktop Pet is Ready!
home_intro.body: Complete these quick steps to start interacting with your new friend on your desktop.

guard.reason: Changing the layout of home_intro to a checklist layout is allowed within onboarding.

candidates.score_note: Finish step has high drop-off, but finish layout changes previously yielded -0.9% lift.

candidates.title: story_quick_start_hint
candidates.change: Add a quick-start helper text hint on the story screen encouraging fast progression.
candidates.why: Choose path takes an average of 514s, showing users spend excessive time contemplating initial steps.

story.hint: Select any path to get started immediately—you can customize your pet anytime!

guard.reason: Adding helper hint text on the story screen is permitted.

candidates.score_note: Low cost helper hint to reduce high mean duration (514s) on choose_path.

candidates.title: sign_in_cloud_save_badge
candidates.change: Display an explicit 'Cloud Save Protected' badge on the sign_in screen.
candidates.why: Sign in has a 27.1% drop-off rate and 8 users suffered account/pet loss confusion.

guard.reason: Adding a reassurance badge on the sign_in screen is allowed.

candidates.score_note: High evidence from funnel and 8 support emails with low implementation cost (badge).

candidates.title: adoption_certificate_fallback_notice
candidates.change: Update adoption certificate copy to reassure users that default pet assets will apply if photo generation fails.
candidates.why: 3 support emails reported custom pet generation failures or unexpected visual bugs.

adoption_certificate.headline: Adoption Confirmed!
adoption_certificate.body: Your pet is being crafted. If custom styling encounters issues, default styles will safely apply.

guard.reason: Updating adoption certificate copy with reassurance text retains core screen functionality.

candidates.score_note: Addresses 3 support tickets, but previous adoption copy changes showed no clear positive effect.

candidates.title: waiting_sound_notification
candidates.change: Enable notify_when_ready and add a pleasant audio chime when pet generation finishes.
candidates.why: Home wait time averages 2336s, indicating users tab away and forget to return when their pet is ready.

components.text: Play notification sound when pet lands on desktop

guard.reason: Enabling ready notifications and audio chimes on the waiting screen is allowed.

candidates.score_note: Helps users who tab away during long home wait time (2336s); notifications showed slight positive lift prior.

lessons_next: Reordering sign-in steps consistently hurt performance across tests.
Adoption copy, finish layout, and home wait-info changes showed no clear effect across tests.
Predictions were consistently too high across almost all tests.
Evidence remains thin for adoption new_flow, choose_path hint, choose_path redesign, finish notification, home new_flow, and sign_in redesign, as each has only 1 test so far.
